shape_note: Card-program templates with symbolic references ($controller, $opponent, $card, $chain_item, $source_object), bound per fixture by r3a1_programs.bind() into a concrete effect-program.v1 / play declaration. No literal player id may appear in a template; fixtures carry `bindings` and every program fixture is also run mirrored (players swapped) and must produce the player-relative same result before a clause can be full or partial. Fixture setups are edits over check_effect_ir.base_state(): u1 = p1 unit 3 Might 1 damage at base; u2 = p2 unit 4 Might exhausted at base; c1,c2 = p1 spells in deck; c3 = p1 spell in trash; c4 = p2 spell in deck; r1 = p1 rune in rune_deck; bf1 empty. Expected outcomes cite the Core clause they follow, not the engine. C-25 (ADR-0007): a clause may carry a `passive` (object_fields on $source_object, or state_lists such as damage_modifiers) applied to the scenario before it runs; a fixture may carry a `probe` (a program or play declaration that is not the card's text but exercises the passive) and a `run` path (play, resolution, effect, play_entry — play a permanent with its entry_location, then resolve by the entry procedure). Stand-ins: Legends are not modelled as objects, so a Legend's passive is anchored to a gear at the controller's Base and the clause says so.
